_comment: INT recording of the default web_ui email route (skills jobhunter-gate and jobhunter-gmail-web) in the tool-call shapes OpenClaw hands the guard, for tests/test_e2e_web_email.py. `pages` are recorded-shape Gmail pages (fictional people, reserved .example domains) in the fake DOM of tests/test_drivers_static.py; the test runs the real drivers on them and puts each driver's output into the evaluate result it belongs to ({LIST_...}, {COMPOSE_OUT}, ...). {URL}, {RECIPIENT}, {SUBJECT}, {BODY_TYPED} and the other names are filled in by the test. Steps with an expect code are mutations the guard must refuse; they never run. `send` confirms with the Sent-folder read-back ({READBACK}, --observed-file); `sent_changed` is the same send whose Sent copy differs from the approved text, so `gate confirm` exits 6 and the token is unknown.
